_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086), set 31/1/3. 27 pages: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-26 (each read at full size), Hindi on every odd index (each the Hindi of the page after it); odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi; last page idx 26 English (Q39). Questions run 1 to 39 unbroken. The marking scheme is a per-set file (cover and every footer read X_086_31/1/3, 11 pages). Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking that scheme: OR after Q22, 24, 32, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39 = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. No void or award-regardless note anywhere in the scheme. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own; each was re-derived and agrees. Decimal points on this paper are RAISED (Q27: 1{\cdot}5 V; Q34: 2{\cdot}5). Sibling of 31/1/1: 43 rows confirmed on the page and copied from it byte-for-byte (stem, context, options, answer, chapter, subtopic, difficulty), 11 rows transcribed fresh (Q5, Q15, Q21, Q22a, Q22b, Q26, Q27, Q30, Q31, Q36a, Q36b, none of them in 31/1/1 or any other committed Science 10 file). Q36(b)(ii) is printed as a question ending in a full stop; kept as printed.
